## Ownership

The files below are installed from the frozen revision with deterministic import-path conversion only. Product Portal, selection, locale and Composer integration lives in `internal/adapters/assistant-ui` and is regenerated by `scripts/sync-product-adapters.mjs`. Vendor product patches are forbidden.

- 50 tracked vendor files
- 30 tracked official Element files
- 154 official Element files discovered upstream
- 124 upstream Element files not adopted into the tracked set
- AG-UI remains at `0.0.59` because it follows the react-ag-ui compatibility matrix

## Upgrade command

`pnpm assistant-ui:update` resolves versions from npm, freezes the official remote main SHA, syncs the vendor, and writes the impact report.

Product integration provenance is recorded separately in `internal/adapters/assistant-ui/UPSTREAM.json`.
